question.text: An intermediary that uses AI and ML tools procured from third-party technology providers is responsible for:

answer.text: Privacy, security and integrity of investors' data only
Output arising from the usage of such tools only
All of: privacy, security and integrity of investors' data; output arising from usage of such tools; compliance with applicable laws

explanation.text: The Logic: As per Section 6.7 and Regulation 16C, any person regulated by SEBI using AI/ML tools is solely responsible for privacy, security and integrity of data, output arising from such usage, and compliance with applicable laws. The Trap: Candidates may think third-party vendors share some responsibility, but the regulation places sole responsibility on the regulated entity. Distributor's Pro-Tip: This regulation means intermediaries cannot shift blame to technology vendors for any AI/ML related compliance failures.
